sources.entry: AliasVault - End-to-end encrypted password manager with a built-in email alias generator and server. (Source Code) MIT Docker

summary.one_liner: AliasVault is a privacy-first, end-to-end encrypted password and email alias manager with a built-in email server, available as a cloud service or self-hosted via Docker.
summary.what_it_does: AliasVault stores login credentials and identities in an end-to-end encrypted vault, and generates random email aliases for each website you sign up to. It includes a built-in email server that receives mail for those aliases, and the README says received emails are encrypted as well. The README lists browser extensions (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari, Brave) with autofill, native iOS and Android apps, a built-in TOTP authenticator, passkey support, and importing from other password managers. Self-hosting is offered through an install script with automatic SSL or a Docker Compose single-container setup for existing SSL infrastructure. The project states a zero-knowledge design where the master password never leaves the device.
use_cases: generate random email aliases to hide my real address
self-host a password manager with Docker
store TOTP two-factor codes in a password manager
replace a closed-source password manager with an open-source one
how_to_run: curl -L -o install.sh <URL not included in README>
notable: Built-in email server that receives mail for generated aliases
Zero-knowledge, end-to-end encrypted vault; master password never leaves the device
Browser extensions, native iOS and Android apps, and a responsive web app
Built-in TOTP authenticator and passkey support
Two self-host paths: automated install script with SSL, or manual Docker Compose
caveats: Self-hosting needs Docker 20.10 or newer on 64-bit Linux, with at least 1 vCPU, 1GB RAM and 5GB free disk (16GB recommended).
FIDO2/WebAuthn hardware key support and family/team sharing are listed as not yet done in the roadmap.
The README says the project is under active development with releases every 2-3 weeks.
